description: This Java source file defines an Android activity named Regions that demonstrates the use of the Region class and related graphics operations such as set operations on regions, drawing rectangles and text on a Canvas, and handling Regions in custom Views.

classes.name: Regions
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating region operations and custom drawing using Canvas within a View.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: A custom View subclass that performs drawing of rectangles, regions, and text illustrating region operations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view to an instance of SampleView.

methods.name: drawOriginalRects
methods.description: Draws two original rectangles on the canvas with anti-aliasing and transparency.

methods.name: drawRgn
methods.description: Creates and combines regions using specified operation, and draws the resulting region on the canvas.

methods.name: drawCentered
methods.description: Draws a rectangle centered around a specified Rect with style adjustments.
